svg.title: RectiRay model and rendering architecture
svg.desc: Schematic, not real feature activations. An original-resolution photograph is letterboxed and normalized to a 224-pixel input. DenseNet201 produces 56 by 56 by 256, 28 by 28 by 512, 14 by 14 by 1792, and 7 by 7 by 1920 feature maps. One-by-one projections to 64 channels and top-down upsampling, addition, and 3-by-3 smoothing produce a shared four-channel spatial map. A flattened direct linear eight readout predicts ordered, unbounded corners. A separate one-by-one mask head is training-only. Pooled conv5 features and detached corners feed a ratio residual on an edge-log baseline. Four corners and full-plane ratio guide a single geometric resampling of the original photograph, yielding observed output and validity. A trusted original with verified provenance follows a separate pixel-exact keep route. Source contract: src/ptrn_hip/partial_model.py PartialModel.forward; src/ptrn_hip/spatial_model.py SpatialModel._spatial_logits; src/ptrn_hip/spatial_objectives.py RatioResidual.forward; src/ptrn_hip/partial_geometry.py rectify_visible.
